```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(ggh4x)
library(viridis)

# Source model + analysis + diagnostics scripts
file_sources <- list.files(here("scripts"), pattern = "*.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(file_sources, source))

base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey50", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey50"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )

square_theme <- theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

label_mass <- function(x) paste0("m = ", format(x, scientific = TRUE), " g")
label_temp <- function(x) paste0("T = ", x, "°C")
label_f <- function(x) paste0("f = ", sprintf("%.2f", x))

add_masks <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      oxygen_exclusion = as.logical(round(as.numeric(oxygen_exclusion))),
      energetic_exclusion = as.logical(round(as.numeric(energetic_exclusion))),
      energetic_exclusion = if_else(is.na(energetic_exclusion), FALSE, energetic_exclusion),
      excl_o2 = oxygen_exclusion,
      excl_e = !excl_o2 & energetic_exclusion
    )
}

plot_surface_masked <- function(df, x, y, z, palette = c("gradient", "viridis", "greens", "purples", "reds"),
                                title = "", fill_title = "", limits = NULL) {
  palette <- match.arg(palette)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]])) +
    geom_raster(data = df %>% filter(!excl_o2, !excl_e), aes(fill = .data[[z]]), interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_raster(data = df %>% filter(excl_e), fill = "grey70", interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_raster(data = df %>% filter(excl_o2), fill = "black", interpolate = TRUE)

  if (palette == "gradient") {
    p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white", high = "#2171b5", name = fill_title,
      na.value = "black", limits = limits, oob = squish
    )
  }
  if (palette == "viridis") {
    p <- p + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", name = fill_title, na.value = "black", limits = limits, oob = squish)
  }
  if (palette == "greens") {
    p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fcf5", high = "#238b45", name = fill_title, na.value = "black", limits = limits, oob = squish)
  }
  if (palette == "purples") {
    p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fcfbfd", high = "#6a51a3", name = fill_title, na.value = "black", limits = limits, oob = squish)
  }
  if (palette == "reds") {
    p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fff5f0", high = "#cb181d", name = fill_title, na.value = "black", limits = limits, oob = squish)
  }

  p +
    labs(title = title, x = x, y = y) +
    base_theme +
    square_theme
}
```

## Traits

```{r traits}
tr <- list(
  a_a = 80, b_R = 0.85,
  a_g = 3, hm = 1,
  f_m = 0.1, b_m = 0.75,
  a_e = 200, b_e = 2 / 3,
  a_c = 60, b_c = 0.75,
  epsAssim = 0.7,
  alpha = 0.2,
  K = 2.0,
  h = 2.0,
  T_ref = 10,
  Q10_m = 2.00, Q10_a = 1.20, Q10_o = 1.50, Q10_c = 2.00
)
```

## Setup A: pO2 vs prey density (mass columns, temperature rows)

```{r setup-a-data}
masses_a <- c(1e0, 1e4)
Temps_a <- c(5, 20)
prey_B_seq <- seq(0.01, 5, by = 0.03)
pO2seq <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.2)

surf_a <- compute_state_surface(
  tr = tr,
  masses = masses_a,
  Tseq = Temps_a,
  pO2seq = pO2seq,
  preys = prey_B_seq,
  prey_units = "biomass",
  pair_mode = "cross",
  progress = TRUE
) %>%
  add_regime_labels_ingestion() %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(mass, levels = masses_a, labels = label_mass(masses_a)),
    T_lab = factor(T, levels = Temps_a, labels = label_temp(Temps_a))
  )
```

```{r setup-a-4panel}
pA_E <- plot_surface_masked(
  surf_a, x = "B_used", y = "pO2", z = "E_net_norm",
  palette = "gradient", title = "Available energy", fill_title = "E/Cmax"
) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(T_lab), cols = vars(mass_lab)) +
  labs(x = "Prey biomass density", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

pA_U <- plot_surface_masked(
  surf_a, x = "B_used", y = "pO2", z = "U_opt",
  palette = "viridis", title = "Cruising speed", fill_title = "U*"
) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(T_lab), cols = vars(mass_lab)) +
  labs(x = "Prey biomass density", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

pA_f <- plot_surface_masked(
  surf_a, x = "B_used", y = "pO2", z = "f",
  palette = "greens", title = "Food limitation metric", fill_title = "f = Cpot/Cmax", limits = c(0, 1)
) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(T_lab), cols = vars(mass_lab)) +
  labs(x = "Prey biomass density", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

pA_g <- plot_surface_masked(
  surf_a, x = "B_used", y = "pO2", z = "g",
  palette = "purples", title = "Oxygen limitation metric", fill_title = "g = Creal/Cpot", limits = c(0, 1)
) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(T_lab), cols = vars(mass_lab)) +
  labs(x = "Prey biomass density", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

(pA_E | pA_U) / (pA_f | pA_g)
```

## Setup B: pO2 vs temperature (mass columns, prey-index rows)


## pO2 vs prey-index diagnostics (individual scales + p_int)

```{r pO2-prey-diagnostics-data}
m_diag <- 1e4
T_diag <- 5
f_seq <- seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01)

surf_diag <- compute_state_surface(
  tr = tr,
  masses = m_diag,
  Tseq = T_diag,
  pO2seq = pO2seq,
  preys = f_seq,
  prey_units = "prey_index",
  pair_mode = "cross",
  progress = TRUE
) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    M_m_norm = M_m / Cmax,
    M_act_norm = M_act / Cmax,
    D_SDA_norm = D_SDA / Cmax,
    Assim_norm = consump / Cmax
  )
```

```{r pO2-prey-diagnostics-plots}
pD_E <- plot_surface_masked(surf_diag, "f_ref", "pO2", "E_net_norm", "gradient", "Available energy", "E/Cmax") +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

pD_U <- plot_surface_masked(surf_diag, "f_ref", "pO2", "U_opt", "viridis", "Cruising speed", "U*") +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

pD_Mm <- plot_surface_masked(surf_diag, "f_ref", "pO2", "M_m_norm", "reds", "Maintenance", "M_m/Cmax") +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

pD_Ma <- plot_surface_masked(surf_diag, "f_ref", "pO2", "M_act_norm", "reds", "Activity", "M_act/Cmax") +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

pD_SDA <- plot_surface_masked(surf_diag, "f_ref", "pO2", "D_SDA_norm", "reds", "SDA", "SDA/Cmax") +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

pD_f <- plot_surface_masked(surf_diag, "f_ref", "pO2", "f", "greens", "Food limitation metric", "f", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

pD_g <- plot_surface_masked(surf_diag, "f_ref", "pO2", "g", "purples", "Oxygen limitation metric", "g", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

pD_pint <- plot_surface_masked(surf_diag, "f_ref", "pO2", "pO2_int", "purples", "Internal oxygen", expression(p[O[2]]^{int})) +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

(pD_E | pD_U) / (pD_Mm | pD_Ma) / (pD_SDA | pD_f) / (pD_g | pD_pint)
```

## Metabolic allocation (stacked, normalized by Cmax, x = size)

```{r metabolic-allocation-stacked}
mass_seq <- 10^seq(0, 4, length.out = 80)
scenarios <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  T = c(5, 20),
  pO2 = c(5, 20),
  f_ref = c(0.6, 0.9)
)

alloc_long <- purrr::pmap_dfr(scenarios, function(T, pO2, f_ref) {
  B_vec <- B_from_f(
    f_ref = rep(f_ref, length(mass_seq)),
    m = mass_seq,
    tr = tr,
    T_ref = T,
    pO2_ref = pO2,
    U_lo = 1e-5,
    U_mech = 5,
    enforce_O2_feasible = TRUE,
    D = 3
  )

  rr <- purrr::map2_dfr(mass_seq, B_vec, function(m, B) {
    st <- find_U_opt(pO2_env = pO2, T = T, m = m, prey = B, tr = tr, U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5)
    tibble(
      mass = m,
      Cmax = st$Cmax,
      Maintenance = st$M_m,
      Activity = st$M_act,
      SDA = st$D_SDA,
      Assimilation = st$consump
    )
  })

  rr %>% mutate(T = T, pO2 = pO2, f_ref = f_ref)
}) %>%
  mutate(
    scen = paste0("T=", T, "°C | pO2=", pO2, " kPa | f=", sprintf("%.1f", f_ref))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Maintenance, Activity, SDA, Assimilation), names_to = "Process", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(value_norm = value / Cmax)

alloc_palette <- c(
  Maintenance = "#b2182b",
  Activity = "#ef8a62",
  SDA = "#fddbc7",
  Assimilation = "#2166ac"
)

ggplot(alloc_long, aes(x = mass, y = value_norm, fill = Process)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.95, linewidth = 0.15, color = "white") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = alloc_palette) +
  facet_wrap(~scen, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Mass (g)",
    y = "Metabolism / Cmax",
    title = "Metabolic allocation (stacked, normalized by Cmax)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  square_theme
```
